Package io.micronaut.dev.compile

@NullMarked package io.micronaut.dev.compile
The compiler contract, with embedded implementations, that turns changed sources into a new generation.
Since:
5.3.0
Author:
graemerocher
  • Related Packages
    Package
    Description
    io.micronaut.dev
    The development mode launcher: MicronautDevMain starts an application behind a reloadable class loader and the DevRuntime recompiles, restarts and reports as sources and resources change.
  • Class
    Description
    ClassDependencyIndex
    Which top-level classes of a class output directory reference which, read from the constant pools of the class files, so that an incremental compilation recompiles the sources whose classes link against a changed class.
    CompilationRequest
    What a SourceCompiler is asked to compile.
    CompilationResult
    What a compilation produced.
    CompilationResult.Status
    The outcome of a compilation.
    CompileDiagnostic
    One message a compiler produced.
    CompileDiagnostic.Severity
    The severity of a diagnostic.
    CompileMode
    Who compiles the sources of a language.
    GroovySourceCompiler
    The embedded Groovy compiler: groovyc through CompilationUnit, with the Micronaut AST transformations the compile classpath carries, run incrementally by StagedSourceCompiler.
    JavacSourceCompiler
    The embedded Java compiler: the JDK's javac through the compiler API, compiling incrementally.
    KotlinSourceCompiler
    The embedded Kotlin compiler: kotlinc through the Kotlin Build Tools API, preceded by KSP when the project has symbol processors, run incrementally by StagedSourceCompiler.
    PythonSourceCompiler
    The embedded Python compiler: the Pyronaut compiler of micronaut-inject-python, which generates the Java stubs and bean definitions of a Python module and compiles them with the module's Java sources, in one javac run.
    SourceCompiler
    Compiles the sources of one or more languages into the class output directory, inside the development JVM.
    SourceKind
    The languages a source root holds.
    SourceRoot
    A directory of sources of one language.
    StagedSourceCompiler
    The incremental flow every embedded compiler shares: which sources to compile, hiding what they and the deleted sources produced before, staging the outputs, and replacing the previous outputs as one transaction on success.
    StagedSourceCompiler.Produced
    What a compilation produced, by the source it was produced for.
